title: 台阶上的箱子  (Left on the Step)

segments.t: It is almost nine in the evening, and the courtyard lanterns glow softly as Qing wraps up her first shift with Chen. Suddenly, the front gate bell rings once in the quiet night. Listen first.
老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
晚上九点？你站这儿，我们一起去开门。
您好？晚上好！院子外头没人啊！
等等，低头看石头台阶上。
又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
欢迎来到小院客栈，小晴。明天不会无聊了。
Now let's go back through the scene, one line at a time.
老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
'Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!' Putting 'arrive' onto 'listen' forms
听到
turning 'listen' into actually 'hear'—the sound reached your ears.
晚上九点？你站这儿，我们一起去开门。
'Nine in the evening? Stay right here; let us go open the gate together.' Mandarin always puts the part of day before the clock hour, so
晚上九点
runs from big unit 'evening' down to 'nine o'clock'.
等等，低头看石头台阶上。
'Wait—look down on the stone step.' Literal and visual,
低头
joins 'lower' with 'head' to say 'look down'.
又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
'Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?' Notice how
宋老师的
drops the word 'suitcase' completely—tacking the possession marker onto a name works just like 'Teacher Song's'.
那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
'Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?' Question word
为什么
literally asks 'for what', sitting smoothly after the subject 'that person'.
我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
'Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.' Look at the calendar pattern in
星期五
where 'week' plus 'five' gives Friday—no separate day names to memorize from Monday to Saturday.
到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
'Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!' Built from 'sign' and 'name',
签名
works both for signing your name and for the signature itself.
欢迎来到小院客栈，小晴。明天不会无聊了。
'Welcome to Courtyard Inn, Qing. Tomorrow will not be boring.' Chen closes with
无聊
everyday Mandarin for 'boring' when a day has nothing interesting to talk about. Now let's listen to the whole scene again from start to finish.
老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
晚上九点？你站这儿，我们一起去开门。
您好？晚上好！院子外头没人啊！
等等，低头看石头台阶上。
又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
欢迎来到小院客栈，小晴。明天不会无聊了。
Teacher Song's suitcase is back, yet the mystery stranger vanished into the night and asked them to guard his bag until Friday. Episode 1 is complete; see you next time for Episode 2.
明天见！
